name: Hans-Peter Meier
bio:
Hans-Peter's journey into motorsport began in his father's precision engineering workshop in the Swiss Alps. Surrounded by lathes and milling machines from a young age, he developed an innate understanding of metalwork. After completing his apprenticeship, he honed his skills at a local racing team, specializing in engine component fabrication. 

Driven by a desire for perfection, Hans-Peter approaches every task with meticulous precision. He is known for his adaptability, quickly adjusting to new techniques and materials. His methodical approach and attention to detail have earned him a reputation as a reliable and skilled machinist, essential to PEX Motorsport's success. He believes in continuous learning, constantly seeking to improve his knowledge of cutting-edge technologies in racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: A sturdy man with a focused gaze and calloused hands, showing the marks of his trade.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting any task
Humming classic Swiss folk songs while working
Carries a small, worn-out machinist's handbook from his grandfather
